# CKEditor - The Only Rich Text Editor Your Application Will Ever Need

> CKEditor is a comprehensive rich text editor with unmatched reliability and a full suite of customizable features. Built for developers, it offers effortless implementation and supports scalable, enterprise-ready applications with tailored, intuitive writing experiences.

## Core Benefits
- Seamless Integration: Easily embed CKEditor into any web or mobile application with support for Angular, React, Vue, and more.
- AI-Powered Content Creation: Enhance productivity with intelligent text suggestions, translation, summarization, and error correction.
- Highly Customizable: Tailor functionality and appearance using a vast ecosystem of plugins, flexible APIs, and customizable themes.
- Enterprise-Grade Security: Built to meet stringent security and compliance standards, ensuring your data and content remain protected. SOC 2 Type 2 compliant.
- Rapid Deployment: Benefit from out-of-the-box features and comprehensive documentation to accelerate your time-to-market.

## Key & Core Editing Features
- Intuitive WYSIWYG Interface: Enjoy a familiar, real-time editing experience with powerful formatting controls.
- Basic Formatting: Bold, italic, underline, strike-through, subscript, and superscript for precise text styling.
- Insert Media & Advanced File Management: Easily add and manage images, videos, and audio files integrated directly into your workflow.
- Hyperlink Management: Insert and manage links with advanced options for target and styling.
- Code Blocks & Syntax Highlighting: Embed formatted code snippets ideal for technical documentation.
- Lists & Tables: Create bullet/numbered lists and customizable tables for structured data.
- Block Elements & Quotes: Use blockquotes, dividers, and callouts to emphasize key content.
- Advanced Styling: Apply inline CSS support and customizable styles for a consistent presentation.
- Responsive & Adaptive Design: Optimized for desktops, tablets, and smartphones to ensure a seamless experience.
- Custom Plugins & API Access: Extend functionality with a rich plugin ecosystem and comprehensive API for custom integrations.
- Collaboration & Workflow Tools: Empower teams with real-time co-authoring, threaded comments, and revision history.

## Tailored Solutions
- Enterprise Solutions: Scalable, secure deployments with dedicated support, SLAs, and custom integrations.
- Developer & Startup Friendly: Rapid prototyping and extensive developer resources for quick integration.
- Content Creators & Marketers: Intuitive tools that streamline digital content creation and publishing.

Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google models, as well as custom LLMs. Available as SaaS and on-premises with MCP support and full data sovereignty.

## Capability Spotlight
- Real-Time Collaboration: Write, review, and comment on content with team members simultaneously. Features include Mentions, Comments, Track Changes, Revision History, and Co-Authoring.
- CKEditor AI: A fully integrated, drop-in AI writing assistant with four core capabilities — AI Chat for brainstorming, drafting, and co-creating content with web search and reasoning; AI Quick Actions for instantly applying transformations (rewrite, summarize, fix grammar) on selected text; AI Review for on-demand document checks against grammar, tone, style, and custom compliance rules with inline accept/reject controls; and AI Translate for translating entire documents into 10+ languages while preserving rich text formatting. The only AI writing assistant that generates output in HTML format, not Markdown — preserving tables, lists, and inline formatting through every edit. Model-agnostic with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and custom LLMs. Supports MCP for connecting external tools, data sources, and AI agents. Available as SaaS and on-premises.
- Enhanced Paste from Word and Excel: Preserve text styles, lists, tables, and layouts when pasting content from Microsoft Word and Excel.
- Import from Word, Export to Word and PDF: Instantly convert content to Word or PDF with a single click while maintaining formatting, comments, page breaks, and embedded images.
- Merge Fields: Add dynamic placeholders that can be replaced with text, content blocks, or images for personalized document generation.
- Multi-level Lists: Create and edit detailed numbered lists (e.g., 1, 1.1, 1.1.1) with legal-style numbering for structured documents

## CKEditor AI

CKEditor AI is a fully integrated, enterprise-ready AI writing assistant that embeds directly into the editor — eliminating the need to switch between apps. It is the only AI writing assistant that generates content in HTML format, not Markdown, preserving rich text structure through every edit.

### Core Features
- AI Chat: Brainstorm, draft, and iterate content in real time. Supports web search, reasoning, and external context via URLs and file uploads. Apply changes directly to the document or insert as tracked suggestions. Includes searchable chat history.
- AI Quick Actions: Apply common transformations (rewrite, expand, summarize, fix grammar, adjust tone) instantly on selected content. Preview changes before accepting. Fully configurable with custom actions for domain-specific workflows.
- AI Review: Run structured on-demand document checks for grammar, clarity, tone, brand compliance, and custom rules (e.g., legal formatting or academic style). Surfaces suggested changes inline with granular accept/reject control. Optimized for large documents via intelligent content chunking.
- AI Translate: Translate entire documents into any language. 10 built-in languages ready to use. Formatting, headings, lists, tables, and inline styles preserved. Original content shown in a sidebar for side-by-side comparison.

### Key Differentiators
- Generates HTML output, not Markdown - preserving rich text structure through every edit.
- Model-agnostic: supports OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), and custom LLMs. Bring your own API keys or connect custom models via on-premises distribution.
- MCP support: connect external tools, data sources, and AI agents directly from within the editor (available in on-premises distribution).
- On-premises distribution with full data sovereignty — queries stay within your security perimeter.
- Role-based access control (RBAC) for AI features, models, and capabilities per user role or subscription tier.
- SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA compliant architecture.
- REST API for using CKEditor AI capabilities programmatically outside the editor.
